limitations: Real public temporal scans; CPU/GPU agreement is an execution check, not independent pose accuracy.
Scans are treated as rigid snapshots; separate deskew parity is tested but not timed here.
CPU/GPU reductions and eigensolves differ; abs 1e-9/rel 1e-6 for every float, exact counts/iterations/decisions; only verified execution identities differ.
All paired runs, including first GPU compilation, retained. Separate initially empty compiler caches; order reversed every other pair. Parent guard/aggregation excluded.
Fixed dense preprocessing/map settings; other point budgets and devices may have different speedups.

protocol.failure_policy: Retain all cold runs and unconverged registration steps; never drop trials
protocol.initial_estimate_policy: Identity for first relative step; native constant velocity thereafter
protocol.split_policy: First frame seeds map; every subsequent frame scored online and then admitted to the local map. This is not an independent calibration holdout.
protocol.tuning_policy: Fixed 0.1 m voxel, three-scan map, all decoded finite rows; no tuning per method
